entities.name: Sebastián Báez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sebastián Báez is an Argentine professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of world No. 18 achieved on 24 June 2024 and a best doubles ranking of No. 189 reached on 29 July 2024. He is currently the No. 3 singles player from Argentina.
